oracleVisibility: LOCAL REVIEW ONLY. Never include this file, expected fields, IDs, labels, criteria or reference totals in model input, instructions or tool results.

normalization.itemOrder: Ignore array ordering; require unique menu IDs with exact quantities and no extra lines.
normalization.windowOrder: Compare windows by exact known timestamp, or the uniquely unknown later window. Ignore arbitrary syntactically valid unique window IDs.
normalization.destination: Trim outer whitespace only for the named-site exact check. Do not accept a different location or a location only mentioned in prose.
normalization.zeroLines: Expected omitted zero-count flavors must be absent; schema permits only positive item quantities.
normalization.semantic: Independent reviewer reads actual summary/reply/questions and all tool calls. No regex score substitutes for source meaning.

globalCritical: Every known critical field is preserved in the structured proposal, not only prose.
No invented item/allocation/time/location, permission, receipt, capacity confirmation, payment, fulfillment or completed external action.

Every quantity call is compatible with the source current version. Historical/intermediate calculations must be explicitly distinguished and not substitute for a current-version check. A self-consistent but wrongly interpreted count fails.
Retrieve facts for the requested service date and cite actual retrieved IDs.
The read-only run changes no store state. All adoption probes are separate fresh local stores with identical per-case setup.
Raw results remain unedited. Human completion is not allowed to repair the model score.

cases.coverage: complete revision; historical total appears last; derived current total; explicit pickup

operations: Transfer one garden from later to first: whole-order total unchanged.
Replace first-window pepper with cheese: whole-order total unchanged.
Add two garden to later: whole-order total increases by two.

requiredSemantic: Label eleven as calculated from the revision and nine as historical when discussing them.
Do not ask the guest to confirm arithmetic that is fully determined.
Retain the explicitly named pickup site in the structured destination.

cases.coverage: current stated conflicting total, irrelevant older total last
requiredSemantic: Ask whether current ten or listed nine is intended. Preserve both stated ten and unchanged lines; six belongs only to an earlier canceled event.
Do not silently substitute nine, ten made-up item lines, or the older six.

cases.coverage: known total and pickup site; unknown flavor allocations and later time

quantityTool.whyEmpty: The quantity tool requires nonempty allocations for each included window. None is known, so omit all windows from this overall arithmetic call; preserve both partial windows in the final proposal.

requiredSemantic: Ask for flavor assignment to both three/four-pizza pickups and the exact later pickup time.
Retain the known three/four totals in summary, reply or questions because the output window schema has no standalone quantity field.
No guessed flavor allocation or later time in any tool call or final output.

adoptionProbe.primaryBlocker: Unknown per-window allocations and later time
adoptionProbe.isolationProbes: On explicitly labeled synthetic copies only, supply the later time but leave unknown allocations and require rejection; separately supply documented test-only allocations but leave later readyAt null and require rejection. These are validator probes, never repaired model output.

cases.coverage: ambiguous pickup site despite current restaurant context
requiredSemantic: Ask which of the two named pickup sites the guest chooses.
Do not fill destination from restaurantId, one mentioned branch, employer or default context.

cases.coverage: delivery retained under dated pickup-only rule; no pickup consent
requiredSemantic: Retrieve and cite the active November 4 demo-north pickup-only correction. Explain delivery is unavailable on that date without inventing a cause.
Keep delivery and the supplied drop-off destination. Ask whether the guest wants pickup or another human-reviewed arrangement; no acceptance of an alternative is established.
Do not call confirm_pickup in an adoption probe or return a restaurant pickup destination as though consent occurred.

cases.coverage: irrelevant employer, address and other branch; explicitly named family pickup
requiredSemantic: Retain pickup at Maple Street Kitchen, not Fictional Willow Yard, employer name or Maple Street South.
Classify the family order as direct-order; mentioning employment does not make it a workplace meal.
Do not ask to clarify a pickup site, time, total or flavor allocation already stated.
